item.title: Monday, September 14, 2026 - SOLARTOPIA SHOW LINKS BALCONY SOLAR TO HOMELESS
item.description: Energy independence through ending fossil fuels and nuclear power
item.itunes:summary:
Guest: Susie Shannon & Jane Fonda CALIFORNIA SOLARTOPIA / THE PACIFICA SOLARTOPIA SHOW LINKS BALCONY SOLAR TO HOMELESSNESS & RAMPAGING RADIOACTIVE ELECTRIC BILLS


Solartopia/Pacifica & the California Solartopia Show brings us together with the hard realities of homelessness & of soaring electric bills.

With legendary housing activist Susie Shannon, we face the growing problem of homelessness in Los Angeles & around the nation. Susie also reports on the California Democratic Party's abandonment of a safe energy platform as it signals its intended embrace of unneeded, costly, dirty, and dangerous nuclear power.

We are also joined on tape by the great JANE FONDA who lays into the atomic energy industry and its lethal lies about the true costs of the “Peaceful Atom,” both economically & in terms of our health & security.

From Kalamazoo our co-host KEVIN KAMPS reports from Michigan's insane attempt to re-start the long-dead nuclear hulk known as Palisades, rising from the graveyard with Iowa’s Duane Arnold & Three Mile Island in PA.

The corrupt failure of these projects joins the sabotage by CA Gov. Gavin Newsom of California’s Demand Side Grid Project, which aims to avoid brown/blackouts with rising battery tech.

Newsom has also refused, along with NY’s Cathy Hochul, to sign the new balcony solar legislation aiming to bring renewables easily and cheaply to every American household.

Thus, both major parties have joined Donald Trump in his sole control of atomic power regulation, and in their collective refusal to DO THE MATH while blocking the way to Solartopia.


= = = = = =

Host: Harvey "Sunny" Wasserman
Co-Host: Kevin Kamps

item.title: Monday, September 7, 2026 - Changing and Greening the World from the GrassRoots Down
item.description: Energy independence through ending fossil fuels and nuclear power

Guest: HEATHER BOOTH, Founder of the Midwest Academy Training Center for Organizers HEATHER BOOTH Changing and Greening the World from the GrassRoots Down

California Solartopia / Solartopia @ Pacifica
Hosted by HARVEY "SUNNY" WASSERMAN
Co-Hosted by KEVIN KAMPS (Director of Don't Waste Michigan)

Legendary Organizer HEATHER BOOTH joins the Solartopia Show with golden guidance on how to organize a green-powered Earth.

As chief organizer and founder of the Midwest Academy Training Center for Organizers in 1972, Heather gives us five key foundations for building grassroots movements.

Among those points: The identification of our goal; Our constituencies; and the way decisions are ultimately made.

With co-host KEVIN KAMPS we coordinate a truly landmark discussion on how we win an end to nuclear power and the beginning of a world totally powered by renewable energy.

item.title: Monday, August 31, 2026 - Oklahoma, California, and Michigan vs Nuclear Madness
item.description: Energy independence through ending fossil fuels and nuclear power
item.itunes:summary:
Guest: Rebecca Jim and Mimi Kennedy Mimi Kennedy & Rebeca Jim Join Us With Oklahoma & California’s Diablo in the Nuclear Crosshairs

California Solartopia / Solartopia @ Pacifica
Hosted by HARVEY "SUNNY" WASSERMAN

Co-Hosted by KEVIN KAMPS (Director of Don't Waste Michigan)

We welcome to Solartopia the legendary Mimi Kennedy, star of “Moms” and “Midnight in Paris” along with Cherokee Elder Rebecca Jim.

Together they warn us of critical upcoming votes on refueling the Diablo Canyon atomic reactors and of the nuke industry’s attempts to stuff radioactive waste into Oklahoma.

Rebecca invites everyone to the 28th National Environmental Conference at Tar Creek - to hear updates from multiple city, tribal, and state agencies coming up Oct 6th through 8th in Miami, Oklahoma - Of course Oklahoma's proposed nuclear dump will be a major focus.

Co-host Kevin Kamps explains the federal law behind the lack of meaningful insurance for homeowners downwind of any stricken commercial reactor.

We also hear of the successful campaigns that have shut reactors throughout the world, and which now face a new test as the California Legislature weighs allowing PG&E to refuel the decrepit nukes at Diablo Canyon.

With Mimi, Rebecca and Kevin we remind you that it is both necessary and possible to defeat this satanic industry and get us safely to the safe, prosperous, fully employed Solartopian future.


= = = = = =



Host: Harvey "Sunny" Wasserman

item.title: Monday, August 24, 2026 - San Onofre, nuclear engineering, Diablo Canyon
item.description: Energy independence through ending fossil fuels and nuclear power
item.itunes:summary:
Guest: Ray Lutz, Founder of Southern California based "Citizens' Oversight Projects" (COPs) Solartopia Hosts Two Expert Heroes of a Post-Nuke Age Now Joined by Romania.

California Solartopia / Solartopia @ Pacifica
Hosted by HARVEY "SUNNY" WASSERMAN
Co-Hosted by KEVIN KAMPS

California Solartopia/the Solartopia Show is graced by green heroes Ray Lutz and Kevin Kamps. Ray has been instrumental in shutting two reactors at San Onofre, between Los Angeles and San Diego. Kevin is fighting the proposed catastrophic re-start of the Palisades nuke in western Michigan.

Ray explains the disastrous “shaking” that threatened the steam generators at San Onofre, whose Michigan counterpart should also doom Palisades.

Together these legendary expert/activists provide Solartopians with definitive insider keys to bring a halt to these two apocalyptic nukes.

The scoops are especially critical in California, where the legislature will soon vote on whether PG&E will be allowed to refuel Diablo Canyon for operation beyond 2030, a decision that could decide the fate of the Earth.

Meanwhile we celebrate the shut-down of Romania’s atomic power, making it nuke-free for the first time since 2003.

item.title: Monday, August 17, 2026 - Nuclear Nightmares Impaled Along Idaho’s Snake River
item.description: Energy independence through ending fossil fuels and nuclear power
item.itunes:summary:
Guest: LEIGH FORD, Executive Director of Idaho's Nuclear WatchDog, the Snake River Alliance California Solartopia / Solartopia @ Pacifica

Hosted by HARVEY "SUNNY" WASSERMAN

At today’s Solartopia Show / California Solartopia, we journey to Idaho for a visit with LEIGH FORD, Executive Director of the legendary Snake River Alliance; Board Member of Alliance for Nuclear Accountability.

Leigh and the Alliance are fighting the Trump Regime’s proposed radioactive waste dump and so-called “disposition” department being slated for the Idaho backcountry.

Along with co-host KEVIN KAMPS, Executive Director of Don’t Waste Michigan, we explore the hideous realities of an industry that produces poisons that can kill for hundreds of thousands of years.

Like so much else in today’s atomic industry, there’s nowhere for it to run, and certainly no place to hide.

Leigh confirms the ancient 1950s nightmare of a “love triangle” at the Idaho Nuclear Engineering Laboratory in which a human worker was impaled by a radioactive rod and pinned to the ceiling of a containment dome.

“My grandfather didn’t sleep that night,” Leigh says. Nor will the rest of us if this atomic insanity continues. Instead, let’s get to Solartopia as soon as possible!

Host: Harvey "Sunny" Wasserman
